helpPlay: p <h>                    play hand card h onto the pile
helpLog: log | l                  show the action log
captureLegend: * = captures the pile (matches the top). † = steals the last capture
promptHelp: p <hand> to play a card (matching the top captures; matching the last capture steals it)
provisionalNote: Note: the running total is your team's captured cards (you + your partner)
